subject: SOC 2 supplemental: user provisioning & auth snapshots
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@carevista.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 supplemental: user provisioning & auth snapshots

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared last week. Our InfoSec team is doing a supplemental evidence pull for our procurement pass and asked for a couple of targeted artifacts that go beyond the standard report. Can you help with the following for the audit period (we currently assume 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 — please confirm):

  - Okta user provisioning/export slice (CSV) that includes create/disable timestamps, source (SCIM/API/console), and admin who triggered the action — sample of ~30 rows across the period;
  - MFA enrollment snapshot (which users had MFA enabled on two checkpoint dates: 2025-11-01 and 2026-03-31);
  - Admin activity extract for privileged users (Okta admin actions) for the audit window;
  - A short note if any identity/provisioning configuration changes (e.g., SCIM connector updates, SSO/IdP config) occurred after the report period that we should ask for a bridge letter about.

We appreciate CSV/TSV samples (redacted as needed) and a plan for delivery (dates + links). If you have a standard runbook that describes your provisioning and deprovisioning process, that would be very helpful too.

Marta Ruiz
Director, InfoSec Operations
CareVista Health

P.S. We can accept attachments or a Drive link and are happy to sign an NDA for sensitive extracts if required.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@carevista.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 supplemental: user provisioning & auth snapshots

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Confirming we received this and we can provide the slices you requested. A few clarifying items before we extract:

  1) Audit period: can you confirm you want 2025-10-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z? We want to make sure timestamps are aligned (UTC vs. PT).
  2) Redaction: we will remove personal email addresses for privacy if requested; would you prefer truncated emails (john****@example.com) or hashed identifiers?
  3) Bridge letter: we will flag any changes that occurred after the period. We also want to confirm whether CareVista needs a formal signed bridge letter or a short statement on letterhead summarizing the change and effective date.

Planned deliverables and tentative timeline:
  - Okta user provisioning sample CSV (30 rows) — delivery 2026-04-13 by EOD PT (okta_enrollment_slice.csv)
  - MFA enrollment snapshot (two checkpoint CSVs) — delivery 2026-04-14 by noon PT (mfa_enrollment_snapshot.csv)
  - Admin activity extract (TSV) for privileged actions — delivery 2026-04-14 EOD PT (admin_activity_okta.tsv)
  - Provisioning runbook (PDF) — delivery 2026-04-15; we can provide an immediate summary in-line if you need it sooner (provisioning_runbook_v2.pdf).

Karthik and Neha — can you validate the exports above and confirm if there are any known post-period config changes we should flag for a bridge letter? I will collect the extracts and share a Drive link.

Thanks — kim

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-13T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 supplemental: user provisioning & auth snapshots

Kim — quick internal note on exports and control changes:

  - Okta CSV: we can produce a CSV with these columns: user_id, email_hashed, action(create/disable), action_timestamp_utc, source(scim/api/console), actor_admin_id. We will hash emails with SHA256 and include a mapping table in the runbook for reviewer use under NDA.
  - MFA snapshots: Okta has per-user factor metadata — we will extract factor.enabled at dates 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z.
  - Admin activity: export from System Log (we'll slice to admin groups only) and format as TSV.

Config change to flag: on 2026-02-20 we rotated and upgraded the SCIM connector to v2.1 to address a mapping issue for group claims. This change occurred inside the audit window (2026-02-20) — we should call this out explicitly in the supplement since it affected provisioning mapping. There was no functional change to the deprovisioning policy, only attribute mapping fixes.

Recommendation: include a short bridging note that: (a) documents the SCIM connector upgrade date, (b) confirms deprovisioning policy remained unchanged, and (c) lists the small mapping adjustments. I can draft the text for legal to sign.

Karthik
Senior Identity Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@carevista.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Hi Marta — sending the agreed deliverables and next steps. Attachments included: okta_enrollment_slice.csv (30-row sample, emails hashed), mfa_enrollment_snapshot.csv (two checkpoint rows per user), admin_activity_okta.tsv (privileged admin actions slice), provisioning_runbook_v2.pdf (process summary). Drive link and ticket below.

Bridge letter: per Karthik's note, we will include a short bridge letter describing the SCIM connector upgrade (2026-02-20) and the scope of mapping changes. Draft bridge letter ETA is 2026-04-16 EOD; if CareVista requires signature earlier we can escalate to Legal.

Links and ticket: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example_drive_link; HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765 (SUP-4321).
